
## (A-H) Signature scores on the all-T MDE {#figs5ah}

```{r figs5ah-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS5.R", "S5a-S5h"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs5ah-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="24%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5a_MDE_dissociation1h.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5b_MDE_dissociation2h.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5c_MDE_ier.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5d_MDE_isr.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5e_MDE_erstress_GO0034976.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5f_MDE_isg_immgen.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5g_MDE_hypoxia_GO0001666.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5h_MDE_mt_genes.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 5A-H.** All-T MDE showing single-cell scores for
representative signatures: (A) 1-hour dissociation and (B) 2-hour dissociation
signatures from van den Brink et al.; (C) immediate-early response signature
from Bahrami et al.; (D) integrated stress response signature from Alicea
Pauneto et al.; (E) ER-stress signature (GO:0034976); (F) interferon-stimulated
gene signature from ImmGen; (G) hypoxia signature (GO:0001666); and (H)
mitochondrial genes. Higher scores are indicated by increasing colour
intensity; scores are capped at the 5th and 99th percentiles.
:::

## (I-K) Mean scores by condition, organ and cluster {#figs5ik}

```{r figs5ik-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS5.R", "S5i-S5k"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs5i-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5i_heatmap_by_condition.png")
```

```{r figs5jk-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5j_heatmap_by_organ.png",
                          "assets/ExtendedDataFigure5/S5k_heatmap_by_cluster.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 5I-K.** Heatmaps of mean signature scores across immune
conditions (I), anatomical sites (J) and immgenT clusters (K), for an expanded
set of stress-related signatures including the ER-stress signature from Chow et
al., the hypoxia signature from Bono et al. and the immediate-early response
signature from Bahrami et al. Values are mean-centred per signature, so colour
is a signature's deviation from its own average rather than its absolute level.
Interferon-related signatures show selective enrichment in specific states,
including CD8.F and CD4.D, whereas most other stress-related programmes are
distributed broadly across clusters, conditions and tissues.
:::
